description: Header file defining LLVM code generation classes and functions for Torch JIT tensor expression, including LLVMCodeGen and LLVMCodeGenBuilder.

classes.name: LLVMCodeGen
classes.description: Class for LLVM-based code generation in Torch JIT tensor expression.

classes.name: LLVMCodeGenBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing LLVMCodeGen instances with configurable parameters.

methods.name: cleanup_memory
methods.description: Cleans up memory used during LLVM code generation, except the generated kernel.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Executes the generated LLVM kernel with provided arguments.

methods.name: call_raw
methods.description: Executes the LLVM kernel with raw pointer arguments.

methods.name: call_with_numel
methods.description: Executes the LLVM kernel with arguments and number of elements.

methods.name: getCodeText
methods.description: Returns the generated code as a string.
